input_policy: reuse frozen E1 pointmap and E2 raw-score argmax labels; no GT input

geometry_gate.normal_estimator: central finite differences on the world pointmap; unsigned angle uses abs(dot)
geometry_gate.local_spacing: median same-label valid 4-neighbor edge length at each endpoint; fallback to scene median

validity: E1 valid mask, finite world point and finite positive geometry confidence
threshold_status: initial pilot settings from the experiment plan; not validation-tuned
temporal_association: deferred when fewer than two keyframes are available
